name: Godzilla
source:
Game is based on the first Godzilla movie. There are three parts - first you investigate the incident - then you pursue the monster and invent what to do with it and finally you confront Godzilla with oxygen destroyer.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作改编自第一部《哥斯拉》电影。故事分为3部分：首先调查事件，然后追踪怪兽并设法找出对策，最后使用“氧气破坏者”与哥斯拉展开决战。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
